unitTitle: A2 capstone: handle a changing week
title: TCF corner
subtitle: A2 · Unit 12: A2 capstone: handle a changing week

steps.title: Exam style
steps.body: These questions look like the real TCF Canada: one play, four options, one answer. A wrong and a blank answer both score zero, so always choose.

steps.fr: Le rendez-vous est jeudi à 14 h. Je vais confirmer le nouvel horaire ce soir.
steps.question: When is the new appointment?
steps.explain: The appointment is moved to Thursday at 14 h.

steps.fr: Il pleuvait quand le bus est arrivé. La deuxième option est plus longue, mais plus simple.
steps.question: What is true about the second option?
options: It is shorter but less clear
steps.explain: The recording directly compares the two qualities.

steps.fr: Pourriez-vous répéter le point de départ ? Je voudrais le noter.
steps.question: What does the speaker want repeated?
steps.explain: The speaker asks to hear the starting point again.
The schedule names the main entrance as the starting point.
steps.promptFr: HORAIRE — Cours : 18 h. Réunion déplacée : jeudi à 19 h. Point de départ : entrée principale.

steps.prompt: Why did the writer choose this option?
options: It is simpler and near the centre
It has a different meeting time
steps.explain: The note says it is the simplest option and the place is near the centre.
steps.promptFr: NOTE PERSONNELLE — Je choisis l'option la plus simple. Elle est plus longue, mais le lieu est près du centre.

steps.prompt: What should the learner do after the practice test?
options: Note an error and choose a point to review
steps.explain: The reminder asks for one error and one review point after the test.
steps.promptFr: RAPPEL — Après le test blanc, une erreur fréquente est dans vos notes. Choisissez un point à revoir demain.
